title: Santosh
desc: A wealthy woman falls in love with a poor man, whom she marries and has a child with, but soon she longs for her old life and abandons both her husband and son. She remarries a rich man, with whom she has another son. Years later, the two boys find themselves on opposite sides of a struggle.

title: Guddu
desc: Guddu and Salina meet with an accident and she loses her eyesight. Later, when Guddu learns that he is terminally ill, he decides to donate his eyes to her, but his father disapproves.

title: Bade Ghar Ki Beti
desc: Mala is a poor girl who marries into a wealthy family at the behest of a patriarch. However, after his death, she must deal with abusive relatives and yet strive to restore harmony in the family.

title: Beti
desc: Sudha assumes a recent acquaintance is the man she's being asked to marry and agrees to the match. When she realises her mistake it's too late, and she has to choose between love and family honour.
